verdict.rationale: Discord is a chat and community platform, so external-partner collaboration is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no guest accounts, cross-organization shared channels, or limited-access partner roles. Private Threads are a related but different feature, and Social SDK provisional accounts are game-player identities rather than team guest access, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access
